notes.title: Island Robot Farm Workshop is Now Live! Come and Build Your Farm Freely!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, farmers![/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that [b]Island Robot Farm[/b] now supports the [b]Steam Workshop[/b]![/p][p]Within the Workshop, we have provided Mod tools, allowing you to unleash your creativity, [b]design and create your own decorative buildings[/b], and use them in your farm![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/007ec1c50e79f19bce6e69284c96778e6a8663b5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Your ideas will become part of the game. Unleash your creativity and upload your creations to the Workshop![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/b5f3d5d0e9e7ee2f46b749db54eb5c6993b265b3.png"][/img][/p][p]Don't forget to browse and subscribe to other players' amazing creations in the Workshop to make your island even more vibrant![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/e375673d63f6fc5015cbe64baeaf7dd0fa6702cc.png"][/img][/p][p]Here are the details for the v1.22 update:[/p][p]1. Steam Workshop is now open! Use the Mod tools to design your own decorative buildings and use them in-game.[/p][p]2. New Feature: Quick task assignment for robots, allowing you to quickly assign tasks to all robots.[/p][p]3. Added 1 new ornamental building: the Giant Drilling Platform, and 1 new large building: the Mega Research Institute.[/p][p]4. Added several new decorative buildings, such as wells, plant crates, fences, island huts, etc.[/p][p]5. Fixed several known issues.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/dddc31e98f458e0a18ea29b8859b31d083d97869.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We sincerely thank every farm manager for your enthusiastic support and valuable feedback.[/p][p]It is your passion that drives us to continuously improve Island Robot Farm. The opening of the Workshop is a brand new starting point, and we can't wait to see the content you create![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🚀🚀[Island Robot Farm] Is Now Available! Build Your Own Island!
notes.notes:
Greetings, farmers! The relaxing and therapeutic sandbox factory-building game [b]Island Robot Farm is now officially launched![/b]

[b]Enjoy a 10% launch discount![/b] Bring home dozens of hours of joyful sandbox farming fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/4d5b9f21c471f69195176e8e70c739155a2b176c.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Full Version Adds Tons of New Content and Gameplay Compared to Previous Versions[/h3]

[h3]1. Brand New Simulation & Management System[/h3]
In the full version, we've developed a brand new simulation and management system!
This includes (but is not limited to): Beverage Factory, Vegetable Juice Factory, and more.
After progressing to a certain point in the game, you can construct new factory buildings and produce goods according to incoming orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/f4fb2b91774aec5094d54954bce242a7c306218d.gif[/img]

[h3]2. New Diving Station System[/h3]

Among the full version's buildings, there's a brand new Diving Station structure featuring the automated Diver Dave! Simply set the collection task, and wait for the goods to arrive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/b2d3942c61583c80dbc1badb0f0c7c0101ae5ae0.gif[/img]

[h3]3. New Rocket System[/h3]

In the full version, farmers can also experience a bit of "Kerbal Space Program". After building the Rocket structure, click launch to embark on interstellar colonization! (The little robots that fly into space will explore, mine, and bring back unique alien plants – like the Mars Flower, a specialty of Mars!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/643bddd002dc77ff19197db0f16846d78e3cedcd.gif[/img]

[h3]4. More and Cuter New Robots![/h3]
For the full version, we've gathered suggestions from our vast community of farmers and created even more adorable little robots! And each one has a significant role to play!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/6337eb51f99605faeef63bb1d2a45c400212bc46.png[/img]

Plus, the full version is packed with even more rich content, waiting for you "farmers" to discover!
